Divinity Original Sin 2 has been broken in Wine for a while, especially on Nvidia hardware. Thankfully, the newly release Definitive Edition seems to work with minimal issues (only encountered one so far, details below).

Note: This involves the DRM-Free version available from the GOG store. The Steam version should work well with Proton, according to others, but not tested personally.

Here is the configuration I used:

Wineprefix = 64bit

Wine Version = 3.15 Staging

DXVK = 0.71

Winetricks Workarounds = vcrun2012 (may not be strictly needed, but the GOG installer attempted to install this component, so I threw it in there for good measure).

Lingering Issues Encountered

Ability cooldown timer has a slight flicker when the cool down is anything greater than 1. Really a minor issue, and everything else in the game appears to work flawlessly, so far as I can tell.

Additional Notes

If using Lutris, make sure Reduce Pulse Audio Latency is disabled, otherwise you will encounter crackling and distorted sound every few minutes - at least, that's how it was in my experience.

Set the game to Fake Fullscreen if you encounter stutter with VSync turned off.
